title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era

claims.claim: Sequoia, London ofisini kapatma ve scout programını sonlandırma kararını X'te yayınlanan bir notla duyurdu.

evidence.quote: Sequoia this week announced a broad overhaul in a memo posted to X, a move that includes closing its London office and shutting down its scout program.

claims.claim: Sequoia, 17 yıl önce seçilmiş kurucuların ve operatörlerin firma adına yatırım yapmasını sağlayan scout modeline öncülük etti.

evidence.quote: That’s partly because 17 years ago, Sequoia pioneered the scouts model, in which select founders and operators write checks on the firm’s behalf.

claims.claim: VC Sheel Mohnot, Sequoia'nın Uber yatırımını kaçırdığını belirterek scout programının hiçbir zaman kendisine mantıklı gelmediğini ifade etti.

evidence.quote: “They pioneered the scout program but [to be honest] it never made sense to me!” VC Sheel Mohnot wrote on X this week. “The scouts themselves don’t really care that much about the investments, you can still miss (like they did with Uber), not sure what it gets you.

claims.claim: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) partneri Gabriel Vasquez, scout programını en iyi insanlara odaklanacak şekilde yenilediklerini ve kişi sayısını azaltıp bütçeyi artırdıklarını belirtti.

evidence.quote: But a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down “on the best people.” Under this new approach, Vasquez explained, scouts get more resources but are also expected to be more active... “They get more budget, but we have reduced the number,” he said.

But a16z partner Gabriel Vasquez told TechCrunch earlier this year that the firm had revamped its program to double down “on the best people.” Under this new approach, Vasquez explained, scouts get more resources but are also expected to be more active, such as by co-hosting dinners with the firm. “They get more budget, but we have reduced the number,” he said.

claims.claim: Station F yöneticisi Roxanne Varza, 2020 ile 2025 yılları arasında Sequoia scout'u olarak görev yaptı.

evidence.quote: Varza, a former Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025, told TechCrunch that she had no information beyond what has been shared publicly...
Varza, a former Sequoia scout from 2020 to 2025, told TechCrunch that she had no information beyond what has been shared publicly

claims.claim: Roxanne Varza, Sequoia'nın programının sonlandırılmasını üzücü bulduğunu ve diğer fonların da aynı yolu izlememesini umduğunu belirtti.

evidence.quote: Among them is Station F boss Roxanne Varza, who wrote on LinkedIn that she was “sad” to hear that the program was getting cut off, and “hope[d] that other funds [w]on’t follow suit.”
